query:
While Jerome was walking Cecilia through a PixInsight Ha-RGB blending workflow, someone in the chat acknowledged following the walkthrough closely but explicitly positioned themselves as outside the narrowband-PixInsight process. Who was that person?

Options:
A. Dev
B. Ruth
C. Marcus
D. Tomás
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, core, t11 @2026-07-10T20:05:00) Still struggling with Ha-RGB blend; thinks there is something deeper missing in how Ha data works.
[2] (about=Cecilia, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Previously thought narrowband was monochromatic and cold; now after Jerome's walkthrough, sees Ha-RGB blend keeps broadband colours and adds depth.
[3] (about=Cecilia, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Ran PixelMath blend on Orion stack and saw HII emission structure around Running Man nebula for first time.
[4] (about=Dev, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Wants to learn PixInsight; Jerome's walkthrough made more sense than YouTube videos.
[5] (about=Dev, said_by=Nadia, profile, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Nadia recommends Dev master eyepiece before software; learning to process before understanding what you're looking at produces technically sharp meaningless pictures.
[6] (about=Harriet, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Will put the PixInsight walkthrough thread in podcast episode notes; it speaks to how amateur astronomy communities work.
[7] (about=Jerome, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Ha-RGB blend requires separate calibration and stacking of Ha, ChannelCombination with Ha mapped to red of synthetic luminance, Luminance mask to protect star colours, and Hue-Saturation adjustment to desaturate magenta cast.
[8] (about=Jerome, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Ha-RGB blend uses PixelMath: Ha_weight * Ha + (1 - Ha_weight) * R, with Ha_weight typically 0.7, to keep broadband colour and add Ha emission.
[9] (about=Jerome, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) DSLR one-shot colour sensor cannot use Ha-RGB blend because it lacks separate Ha data.
[10] (about=Jerome, core, t6 @2026-04-03T20:04:00) Offered to help Cecilia with PixInsight workflow; says muddy Ha channel likely due to background extraction before separating channels.
[11] (about=Jerome, core, t8 @2026-05-08T20:16:00) States colour separation in his Rosette image comes from Ha-only workflow; mono sensor reads every photon with equal weight, DSLR cannot replicate due to physics.
[12] (about=Jerome, core, t7 @2026-05-08T20:15:00) Completed 22.4 hours Ha integration of Rosette Nebula across 9 nights with 3nm Chroma filter; SNR 47 at faintest shell edge.
[13] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-07-10T20:42:00) Dev, I would recommend mastering the eyepiece before the software. In my experience learning to process an image before you understand what you are looking at produces technically sharp meaningless pictures. But the question is a good one and Jerome is the right person to answer it.
[14] (about=Priya, profile, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Priya says Cecilia's Orion Ha-RGB shows actual physics; line between pretty picture and science image.
[15] (about=Tomás, core, t12 @2026-07-10T20:07:00) Not happy with barn door setup anymore; wants to eventually do Ha-RGB blend like Cecilia.
agent_answer:
D. Tomás

Tomás is the one who acknowledged following Jerome’s walkthrough closely while placing himself outside the narrowband‑PixInsight workflow: he’s currently not doing that kind of process with his barn-door setup, but wants to eventually do an Ha-RGB blend like Cecilia.
